The company manufactures and tints paint at its head office plant (Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture), the Tokyo plant, the Chiba plant and others, and sells it partly directly to customers and mainly through exclusive dealers. The consolidated subsidiary Daiyasu Kasei Co., Ltd. and the equity-method affiliate Yūshin Shokai Co., Ltd. also handle sales of the company's products.
